waypoints.label: Trailhead
waypoints.title: Start at the gravel lot
waypoints.caption: Park at the end of Cedar Creek Road. The trail leaves from the far corner of the lot, past the map board.

waypoints.label: Creek junction
waypoints.title: Left at the creek junction
waypoints.caption: Cross the creek on the flat rocks, then turn left at the cedar with the split trunk.

waypoints.label: Spring
waypoints.title: Seasonal spring
waypoints.caption: A pipe spring just off the trail on the right. Reliable until about mid-July.

waypoints.label: Ridge junction
waypoints.title: Stay left toward the ridge
waypoints.caption: At this junction, stay left toward the ridge. The right fork drops back to the road.

waypoints.label: Slick slab
waypoints.title: Watch your footing on the slab
waypoints.caption: A short stretch of bare granite just below the overlook. It stays wet into the afternoon after rain; stay on the left edge where the moss is thin.

waypoints.label: Overlook
waypoints.title: Overlook, take a breather
waypoints.caption: Open rock with views east over the valley. Good lunch spot.

waypoints.label: Saddle road exit
waypoints.title: Saddle road exit
waypoints.caption: A forest road crosses the saddle here. Follow it downhill 1.5 miles to the paved road if you need to cut the loop short.
